purpose_zh: 在不改变任何正式几何和指标的前提下，把同源空间证据重新排成总体关系图、三处重点区放大图、廊道交叉图和指标回读图；放大框、节点族和人工接管文字都回指包内 GeoJSON 与场景台账。
purpose_en: Without changing formal geometry or metrics, reorganize the same spatial evidence into an overview, three focus-area zooms, a corridor-crossing map, and a metric readback board; zooms, node families, and staffed-takeover text all return to bundled GeoJSON and scenario records.

display_method.coordinate_rule: projected easting/northing are transformed only for display so north reads to the right on the elongated corridor
display_method.display_aspect_rule: the map panels may expand the short axis for legibility; no pixel distance, pixel area, or visual proportion is used as a metric
display_method.zoom_rule: each focus-area inset uses the exact submitted feature outline plus intersecting local layers; it is not a surveyed detail plan
display_method.metric_rule: all displayed areas, ratios and lengths remain the values in metrics.json or recomputation from package GeoJSON in EPSG:4548

figure_outputs.readability_addition: three focus-area insets and a right-hand evidence checklist
six color-keyed units with shared-edge and coverage rule
three exact-outline zooms paired with differentiated action chains
four corridor cards and a repeated crossing-node safety rule

limits_zh: official_boundary=false，geometry_role=provisional_constraint；放大框不是官方红线、测绘图或工程详图。
所有空间动作仍为概念建议/参考方案，供专业团队深化研究。
显示变形只为阅读，不改变 metrics.json、GeoJSON、面积、占比或线长。
居民、就业、人工服务、PUE、绿电和余热等结果仍为 unknown。
limits_en: official_boundary=false and geometry_role=provisional_constraint; zooms are not official redlines, surveys, or engineering details.
All spatial actions remain conceptual suggestions or reference schemes for professional teams to deepen.
Display expansion is for reading only and changes no metrics.json, GeoJSON, area, ratio, or length.
Resident, employment, manual-service, PUE, green-power, and recovered-heat outcomes remain unknown.
